programmes.t: The Best of the Dean Martin Show
programmes.d: Sketches and songs with Dean Martin and celebrity guests John Wayne, Rowan & Martin, and Gail Martin.
Bernadette Peters and Cass Elliot guest star in the latest "As The Stomach Turns", and Lyle causes havoc and absurdity on a live television production as a drunken sound effects operator.

programmes.t: The Best of the Carol Burnett Show
programmes.d: Tim Conway hops a plane with the cast for a performance in Sydney, Australia!
Nanette Fabray and the lovely Michele Lee guest star in another hilarious episode that includes a commercial take-off and the continuing story of the soap opera spoof "As The Stomach Turns."
Eight-time Emmy winner, Betty White wanted to be a forest ranger, but that gig was off-limits to women in the early 1940s. She turned to writing and was the first woman to produce a sitcom.

programmes.t: The Best of The Ed Sullivan Show
programmes.d: Ed Sullivan presents The Rolling Stones, Louis Armstrong, Joan Rivers, Jim Nabors, Holiday on Ice, and Robert Goulet.
Guest star William Conrad appears in the latest "The Family" sketch, as a gentleman caller for Mama (Vicki). Also: Harvey's uncomfortable news for his wife (Carol) gives her a bad case of twitches.
Guest Ken Berry joins Carol in a salute to Warner Brothers, with a pair of spoofs of "Mrs. Skeffington" and "Yankee Doodle Dandy."
Comedienne Joan Rivers kills the crowd with her comedy set, while The Old Folks and the 10th Avenue Family appear in sketches that keep the audience rolling in the aisles.

programmes.t: The Best of the Dean Martin Show
programmes.d: Sketches and songs with Dean Martin and celebrity guests Joey Bishop, Leonard Barr, and Flip Wilson.
Carol's guests are Carol Channing and Steve Lawrence in this episode, which features the latest "As The Stomach Turns", and a "Carol & Sis" with Roger and Carol finding themselves in a nudist colony.
Carol's good luck charm Jim Nabors guest stars! This episode is highlighted by Harvey's belated Emmy Award acceptance speech, and a Nostalgia Theatre presentation of the WWII-set "Hollywood Canteen."
Hulkomania takes over The Tonight Show! How do George Miller and Brooke Shields follow that??
15-year-old TV star Ricky Schroder tells Johnny that when he gets his license, he wants to buy a Corvette. Also chats about dating, getting good grades in school, and learning to sing.

programmes.t: The Best of the Carol Burnett Show
programmes.d: On 'Carol & Sis, Carol suffers under the lingering spell of a hypnotist. And in the latest 'As The Stomach Turns', Shirley takes aim at Carol.
Buddy Hackett has knowledge on many subjects, including snakes. Dr. Morris Goldberg talks chauffeuring and Johnny addresses George Brett's hemorrhoids.

programmes.t: The Best of the Dean Martin Show
programmes.d: Sketches and songs with Dean Martin and celebrity guests Gina Lollobrigida, Milburn Stone, and Norm Crosby.

Wild and crazy guy Steve Martin does card tricks, George Foreman talks winning the heavyweight championship and Johnny details his valentine from Don Rickles. Sandy Duncan and Binnie Barnes also appear.
Harvey Korman regales Johnny with a story about Tim Conway taking his pants off in public. Ron Lucas and Jane Pauley also appear but have no stories about public indecency.

programmes.t: The Best of The Ed Sullivan Show
programmes.d: Ed Sullivan presents Elvis Presley, Carol Burnett, Arthur Worsley, Lena Horne, and The Six Guttis.
Carol welcomes Joel Grey and Cass Elliot as her guests! Highlights include a salute to Foreign Language films, and a sketch featuring Joel, Harvey, and Lyle as puppies in a pet store window.
Calling all coffee fans: Jerry Seinfeld serves his take on the phenomenon. Also waxes hilarious about the 1992 Olympics.
Frequent guest Charles Grodin discusses his movie The Lonely Guy, which also stars Steve Martin. Also featured are radio legends, Bob & Ray.
The brilliant Jonathan Winters guests as a pair of airport patrons interviewed by Harvey. And in "Carol & Sis", Carol and Harvey struggle to remember the names of their visiting old dear friends.
Tim Conway and Harry Anderson stop by to chat with Johnny.

For a guest like Tim Conway, Carol's door is always open! Tonight, Tim's engagement ring for Carol, made from the cursed Hope Diamond, causes no end of bad luck for them. Also featured: "Carol & Sis."

Comedian Alan King guest stars as Carol's distracted psychiatrist. Also: an exhausted Carol tries to make hubby Tim breakfast; a nurse (Vicki) and patient (Carol) recognize each other from high school.

programmes.t: The Best of the Carol Burnett Show
programmes.d: Carol offers a trio of guests: Lucille Ball, Eddie Albert, and Nancy Wilson!

programmes.t: The Best of the Carol Burnett Show
programmes.d: Steve joins Carol in a sketch about a travelling couple sharing some honesty with each other on a plane they think is about to crash.
Who’s racked up more Emmys than anyone except Julia Louis Dreyfuss and Carl Reiner? Cloris Leachman. She talks to Johnny about growing up in Des Moines and doing live TV.
Remember Ricardo Montalban’s “rich Corinthian leather?” The king of kitsch (Fantasy Island, 3 Planet of the Apes movies and Star Trek tv series and movie) reveals his obsession with bullfighting!

programmes.t: The Best of the Carol Burnett Show
programmes.d: Guest James Coco takes a slow boat to romance in the Saturday Night Tearjerker movie spoof, 'One Way Ticket'
Guest star George Gobel joins Carol in a "V.I.P." interview of a Duke and Duchess living in squalor in New York. The latest "Carol & Sis" sketch doubles as a prank on an unsuspecting Harvey Korman.
